resources.string: Manage local rules to hide unwanted videos
Tap for scope, matching rules and network usage details

Rules are stored only on this device; no login is required. Matches full website tag or author names, ignoring case, character width and surrounding whitespace, not title substrings. Use the exact Chinese spelling shown on the website. Applies to Home (including banners), Search and Related videos. Does not delete favorites, watch-later items or downloads, or prevent opening a video directly. Missing metadata requires extra video-page requests (up to 3 at once), cached for 30 minutes. Cards that cannot be verified stay hidden; pull to refresh to retry.
